exemptionRationale: Pure documentation finding: the owner is a JSDoc block comment, which TypeScript strips at emit, so no executable behavior, type, or public API surface can depend on it — a RED behavioral assertion is not constructible. Verified that nothing consumes the docblock: grep across the repo for 'skills-conformance-check'/'checkSkillLocalScripts' finds only behavioral tests (skills-conformance-check.test.ts, claude-plugin-manifest.test.ts, conformance/*.test.ts), CLI wiring and prose docs — there is no typedoc, API-extractor or doc-generation step reading it, and no existing test asserts on this module's own source text. The only test expressible would be a source-string assertion pinning the exact prose of one comment in one file, which has no precedent in this repo's conformance harness (it checks corpus and structural invariants, never per-file comment uniqueness) and would fail CI on any legitimate future rewording of the block — a brittle guard disproportionate to the defect. The contract is therefore carried by six deterministic committed oracles above, all measured at base, including the interaction row that catches the measured false green the plan's single grep-count oracle would have passed.
